precommitted_selection_rule: SELECT SOLELY BY ticket-group CV mean (pre-committed): the group winner is the finding, regardless of random ranking.
precommitted_adopt_rule: Recommend ADOPT-FOR-V2 ONLY if the group winner ALSO satisfies ALL THREE: (1) random cost vs reference <= 0.0067, (2) paired-t vs reference on group folds >= 2.0, (3) group-OOF Brier not worse by > 0.002 (winner_group_brier - ref_group_brier <= 0.002). Otherwise RETAIN (record group ranking as evidence only).

protocol.sgkf_note: Runtime-verified via inspect.signature on sklearn 1.9.0: shuffle=True+random_state=42 supported and used; groups = X['Ticket'].astype(str).str.strip() (681 groups).
protocol.fairness: Identical precomputed split indices reused for all 5 candidates (fair paired comparison); one fit per fold yields both accuracy and OOF proba for Brier; accuracy at fixed 0.5 threshold; OOF Brier = mean((oof_proba - y)^2).
protocol.std_convention: std_pop = population ddof=0 primary (matches project); std_sample ddof=1 also recorded; paired-t uses sample std ddof=1: t = mean(diff)/(sd(ddof=1)/sqrt(5)) on same 5 group folds (candidate - reference).
protocol.fits: 5 candidates x 2 CV schemes x 5 folds = 50 fits

selection.note: Complete reversal: reference is 1st on random but 5th (last) on group; LR is 1st on group but 5th (last) on random. Group-CV-first selection picks a different model than random-CV-first selection did.

gate1_random_cost_le_0_0067.reason: ref_random 0.843977151465696 - LR_random 0.828278199736363 = 0.015699 > 0.0067 -> FAIL; LR costs ~1.57 pts of random-CV accuracy vs reference.

gate2_paired_t_ge_2_0.reason: Mean group diff +0.031467 with sd_ddof1 0.030377 gives t=2.3163 >= 2.0 -> PASS on identical 5 group folds.

gate3_brier_not_worse_by_gt_0_002.reason: Group-OOF Brier LR 0.132406 - ref 0.144011 = -0.011605 <= 0.002 (LR better by ~0.0116) -> PASS; gate uses group Brier (selection domain); random Brier delta +0.003448 reported for transparency only.

verdict_rationale: Group winner LR_C05 selected solely by group mean (0.830549 > C1-lean 0.821528 > simple 0.809231 > GB 0.804718 > ref 0.799081), differing from random winner ref_tuned_RF. ADOPT requires ALL three gates; gate1 FAILS (random cost 0.015699 > 0.0067) while gate2 passes (t=2.3163) and gate3 passes (group Brier delta -0.011605). Hence RETAIN: record group ranking as evidence only, do not adopt LR as new submission pipeline; no submission.csv generated.
